title: Weltgewebe source-task materialization
goal: Materialize explicitly approved Weltgewebe source tasks into Bureau without reinterpreting the source repository status or creating a second source of truth.
completion: Every materialized WG-* task remains bound to an exact Weltgewebe source task hash and source commit.
Terminal Bureau execution evidence never upgrades a partial or blocked Weltgewebe source status by implication.
Duplicate materialization is blocked by the canonical WG-<source-task-id> identity.

metadata.source_authority_boundary: The source snapshot is an import/projection only; Bureau task state records execution lifecycle, not source epistemic truth.
